compiled_kernel_resources.scope: Static compiler declarations, not measured occupancy.

implementation: A76-byte row retains16 exact FP16 integer cores with original sign bits, four low-byte residue words, four packed trailing-count words, packed unit/max/eligibility and exception/nonzero masks, plus initialized padding. Non-exception original BF16 is reconstructed from the exact half exponent and significand; unsupported rows or exceptions read original BF16 with explicit stride. One zero-C FP16 WMMA estimate and one exact IU8 low-byte WMMA recover the signed32 mathematical core dot subject to an explicit native error<128 condition. Window4/8 stages both products and consumes actual carries in order. A carry that dominates row maxima in the bounded domain uses sparse per-product remainders and original BF16 exception compensation; unsigned modulo sign disambiguation and canonical normalization remain. Rejected groups use original scalar float alignment when eligible and original packed integer arithmetic otherwise. Original transposed keys are produced by the candidate own key encoding and included in preparation timing. No product dispatcher changes.
correctness_scope: All65536 BF16 encodings in five row contexts are checked on the host, including signed zero, unsupported encodings, strided exception access and null original pointers for recoverable elements. Sanitizers compare917504 input/carry combinations and every fallback against independent wide sums. A separate native primitive checks2097152 matrix cells against independent CPU integer dots and four exact IU8 control products; finite maximum error is reported, not a universal proof. Native60 QK reports compare every generated score and mask, with3840 independent CPU dots. Captured warmup and all three measured attempts verify all scores, guards, unused tails, complete compact encodings and original key transposition. Audits run outside timers, check output parity and exact group/recovery counts across both windows. q8192 repeats1023 original q7169 rows; it is a component extension, not a new model prompt or GB10 token loop.
timing_scope: One warmup plus three completed host samples per query slab; variants rotate across slabs. Candidate clocks include each slab query encoding, staged products, sparse corrections and scalar fallback, plus one complete key encoding and original key transpose. Control includes its own complete Q/K encoding and transpose once. Allocation, resets, comparison, CPU encoding checks and audits are excluded. No load time, TTFT, decode or retained performance is inferred.

decision.reason: All compared QK scores and finite native integer recoveries pass, but compact window4 adds1184.3175ms at the q8192 component versus selected prepared QK; window8 is slower still. The76-byte payload, two rather than four matrix operations and original scalar fallback do not offset observed complete work. This comparison does not isolate memory traffic, barriers, sparse exception gathering or occupancy as causes. The native error condition remains unproved universally. Retain the current product stack and continue structural routes against measured walls.
decision.next_investigation: Evaluate a block error envelope based on actual native partial prefixes. Host-only captured samples reduce conservative replay counts but do not establish native performance; combine tighter certification with meaningful full-shape measurements before integration.
